「It's ironic... Only after ending up like this... am I finally free of the $$インプラント$$s...」

676:t_3:37.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Why are you saying this now...?!」

676:t_3:38.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「At first... out of revenge... I thought... of using the $$バジュラ$$... and tried... to make you... my tool for that...」

676:t_3:39.en:
$$グレイス#pilot$$
「But I... found myself... captivated... by your songs...」

676:t_3:41.en:

676:t_3:54.en:

$$アルト$$
「Thank you, $$ランカ$$, for loving someone like me.」

676:t_4:6.en:
$$シェリル$$
「What are you saying, $$アルト$$?! I won't let you leave $$ランカ$$-chan behind!」

676:t_4:8.en:
$$シェリル$$

676:t_4:13.en:

676:t_5:4.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...So the $$ガイゾック$$, who destroyed the $$ビアル星人$$, came to see humanity as an enemy because of the $$御使い$$s...」

676:t_5:5.en:
$$勝平$$
「They said that if humanity developed its civilization, it would summon the $$御使い$$s.」

676:t_5:6.en:
$$万丈$$
「By that logic, the $$ガイゾック$$'s $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$ came to judge humanity's very existence as something that summoned them... as evil.」

676:t_5:7.en:
$$シン$$
「That's bullshit...! Are you saying that as long as the $$御使い$$s exist, humanity has no right to live?!」

676:t_5:8.en:
$$勝平$$
「I felt the same way you do, Big Bro $$シン$$. That's why I fought them.」

676:t_5:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「But it seems the $$御使い$$s have affected many worlds more than we imagined.」

676:t_5:10.en:
$$隼人$$
「They were the ones who declared the $$インベーダー#robot$$s to be $$バアル$$, too.」

676:t_5:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The way you put it, they weren't originally $$バアル$$...」

676:t_5:12.en:
$$號$$
「One of the defining traits of $$バアル$$ is that communication is impossible, but...」

676:t_5:13.en:
$$號$$
「At least the $$インベーダー#robot$$s that parasitized $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$ understand human language.」

676:t_5:14.en:
$$刹那$$
「So you mean communication is possible?」

676:t_5:15.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Even so, in practice, their own evolution comes first, and they regard every other life-form as an enemy.」
